solver_methods.name: GTSAM Sparse
solver_methods.configuration: Incremental factor-graph solves with COLAMD; proximal weight 1e-9 on MPC, cached RHS solves for center changes; zero additional regularization on G1

solver_methods.name: GTSAM Chronological
solver_methods.configuration: The same sparse solver with chronological state blocks and shared-variable retirement; G1 only

solver_methods.name: GTSAM Slice COLAMD
solver_methods.configuration: Chronological slice groups, constrained COLAMD within each group of original key blocks; G1 only

solver_methods.name: GTSAM Dense
solver_methods.configuration: Packed square-root costs, cached objective QR and lazily transformed normals, QR row updates, rank-aware null-space fallback; MPC only

solver_methods.name: GTSAM ALM
solver_methods.configuration: Native BCL penalty updates and Levenberg–Marquardt inner solves with a persistent nonlinear multifrontal workspace; zero initial values

solver_methods.name: DAQP
solver_methods.configuration: Recursive LDLᵀ updates; dense MPC only; version 0.8.7 uses selective proximal regularization for weak curvature

solver_methods.name: Clarabel
solver_methods.configuration: Primal-dual interior-point steps toward the constrained optimum

solver_methods.name: OSQP
solver_methods.configuration: Alternates linear-system solves and projections onto constraint bounds

solver_methods.name: ProxQP
solver_methods.configuration: Solves regularized subproblems with semismooth Newton inner iterations
